    Upper Egypt Transmission project, Maghagha Substation 220/66/33/11 kV 2 * 75
    MVA
    The Egyptian Electricity Authority (EEA) has obtained a loan from the
    European Investment Bank (EIB) to co-finance Upper Egypt Transmission
    project.
    It is intended to apply part of the proceeds of this loan to eligible
    payments under the contract for which this invitation to tender is issued.
    EEA invites tenderers from eligible international firms for execution of
    Maghagha 220/66/33/11 kV, 2 * 75 MVA substation.
    The tender consists of 2 packages (A and B).
    Package A:
    Includes, but not limited to, the design, manufacture, supply, transport,
    civil works, project management, erection, testing, setting to work and
    commissioning in accordance with tender documents and on turnkey job basis,
    of the 220, 66, 33 and 11 kV switchgear, protection, control, metering and
    all other ancillary equipment including erection of the transformer supplied
    under Package B.
    Package B:
    Comprises the supply CIF site and supervision of erection of the main
    transformers (220/66/11 kV, 75 MVA) and (66/33/11 kV, 25 MVA).
    Tendering for package A and B is open to tenderers from at least the member
    countries of the European Economic Community (EEC) and Arab Republic of
    Egypt (ARE).
    General:
    1. Tenderers are entitled to bid for either package A or B or both packages.
    2. The tender documents are available at EEA cashier against presentation of
    payment receipt of USD 1 000, from National Bank of Egypt (NBE) main branch
    EEA's account No 1880/90/14 together with an application (original plus 2
    copies) showing the name, address, telex and telephone number of both
    supplier and local agent and addressed to General Director of Central
    Purchases Department during official working hours.
    3. Tenders to be submitted according to tender conditions in 2 envelopes.
    _ Envelope No 1 contains the technical proposal and reference list together
    with a letter from first class bank confirming submission of the bid bond (2
    %) with envelope No 2;
    _ envelope No 2 contains the price proposal and bid bond amounting to 2 % of
    the total tender value in freely convertible currency.
    4. Interested tenderers should submit envelope No 1 to EEA, Central
    Purchases Department, by 14. 4. 1993(12.00) hours.
    Tenders will be opened on the same date at 12.00.
    5. Envelope No 2 will be submitted later. The date will be defined and
    announced by EEA in due time.
    6. Interested tenderers may obtain further information regarding tender
    documents from Egyptian Electricity Authority, Central Purchases Department,
     Abbassia, Nasr city, EG-Cairo.
